m.english: She wanted to test her husband, but she couldn't have made a worse move.

target.text: Ela querida testar seu marido, mas ela não poderia ter feito algo pior.

translation.text: She wanted to test her husband, but she couldn't have made a worse move.

m.target: Ela querida testar seu marido, mas ela não poderia ter feito algo pior.

u.english: One only has one chance to prove such a theory. Why?

target.text: Só tinha uma hipótese de testar a teoria.

translation.text: One only has one chance to prove such a theory. Why?

u.target: Só tinha uma hipótese de testar a teoria.

u.english: You want to take your chances with the others, be my guest.

target.text: Se queres testar as tuas hipóteses com os outros, fica à vontade.

translation.text: You want to take your chances with the others, be my guest.

u.target: Se queres testar as tuas hipóteses com os outros, fica à vontade.

u.english: Just grab another saw. Well, I'm going to test this one for a third time, just to be sure.

target.text: Vou testar esta pela terceira vez, só para ter a certeza.

translation.text: Just grab another saw. Well, I'm going to test this one for a third time, just to be sure.

u.target: Vou testar esta pela terceira vez, só para ter a certeza.

u.english: Send one of us through to test the waters, if you get my drift.

target.text: Um de nós testar a água, se é que me entendes.

translation.text: Send one of us through to test the waters, if you get my drift.

u.target: Um de nós testar a água, se é que me entendes.

u.english: So he uses his friend Hanim to test the waters.

target.text: Então ele usa o amigo para testar as águas.
